verdict.rationale: Wave's own docs say the Pro Plan automatically imports, merges, and categorizes bank transactions, which covers automatic categorization of imported transactions. Nothing in the evidence shows categorization presented as reviewable suggestions, or a system that learns from user corrections or applies rules. Missing for 10: evidence that categorization learns from corrections, a suggestion/review workflow, rule creation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: With the Pro Plan, automatically import, merge, and categorize your bank transactions.
